data_origin: synthetic: seeded generator (src/detect/generator.cjs), not production traffic

definitions.incident_match: An alert matches a labelled incident when their event IDs intersect; one-to-one greedy matching by largest overlap.
definitions.recall: matched incidents / all incidents, evasive ones included (incident level).
definitions.f1: harmonic mean of incident-level precision and recall.
definitions.tta_ms: emission time minus receipt of the last evidence event the alert needed, on the simulated collector clock (includes the reorder-buffer wait, up to the lateness), plus measured processing time per event.
definitions.event_level: event IDs covered by alerts vs event IDs belonging to incidents; reported separately, never mixed with incident metrics.
definitions.evasive: attacks generated to stay under the rule thresholds (low-and-slow, two denied edges); misses are reported, not tuned away.
